purpose: Required control: a dictionary-derived object-function baseline that produces 4 tags in the SAME format WITHOUT any varṇa input. If it matches or beats A_real, the Symbol-U-specific claim FAILS (the modulation is re-derivable from ordinary object semantics).

construction.input: dictionary anchor / object function ONLY (no varṇa input)
construction.method: extract the anchor's function head + salient object properties by a FIXED deterministic rule (e.g. WordNet gloss / hypernym / function-word extraction), reduce to <=2-word tags, take first 4
construction.output_format: Within the fixed meaning, this object is modulated by {tag1}, {tag2}, {tag3}, and {tag4}.

illustrative_examples_not_final.note: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY — NOT FINAL STIMULI, NOT EVIDENCE

role_in_study.comparison: semantic-only baseline vs A_real is a REQUIRED comparison
role_in_study.success_requirement: A_real must beat OR add beyond the semantic-only baseline
role_in_study.fail_rule: if the semantic-only baseline matches or beats A_real, the Symbol-U-specific claim FAILS
role_in_study.restatement_guard: if A_real wins ONLY because its tags coincide with the dictionary-derived function tags (i.e. it merely restates object function), that is a FAIL, not a signal

separation_from_X_neutral.X_neutral: content-FREE generic filler tags; tests whether ANY modulation beats nothing
separation_from_X_neutral.semantic_only_baseline: dictionary-derived object-function CONTENT; tests whether varṇa beats ordinary object semantics
